name: Grandmaster Mantak Chia
reason: Health rule: his own site (mantakchia.com) carries direct medical claims: the About page says his Tao Garden spa (which he founded and runs in Chiang Mai) 'provides colon therapy, stem-cell cancer prevention, and natural cancer cure treatments', and the home page features a testimonial that the Healing Tao reversed osteoporosis. His system (Universal Healing Tao) is sold largely on healing, and his Shift courses are framed around 'luminous health', longevity and self-healing. Under the strict rule (cure claims on the teacher's own pages) he is skipped. A human may want to reconsider, given his stature (60+ books) and the clean Taoist inner-alchemy retreats (Darkroom Retreat Feb 2027, Winter Retreat Jan 2027); contact is a form only.
